recognize_zh: 高倍網狀纖維染色可見大量粗黑纖維彼此交錯並聚成粗束，整個視野幾乎沒有造血細胞，只剩少數小血管空隙，屬於最高等級 MF-3 的骨髓纖維化。
features: Dense, diffuse meshwork of coarse black reticulin fibers with extensive intersections throughout the field
Thick parallel fiber bundles streaming across the right half of the image
Few small vascular or sinusoidal lumens embedded in the fibrotic stroma
Hematopoietic precursors essentially absent; no fat cells retained
Collagen deposition cannot be confirmed without a trichrome stain
describe_en: High-power view of a reticulin-stained bone marrow trephine shows a diffuse and dense increase in coarse reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and thick bundles. Small vessels are entrapped within the fibrous stroma, and residual hematopoietic cells and adipocytes are virtually absent. Findings correspond to WHO reticulin grade MF-3, consistent with advanced (overt fibrotic) myelofibrosis; trichrome staining would assess associated collagen.

ddx.vs: MF-1 shows a loose network of thin fibers with many intersections, especially perivascularly, rather than coarse bundles replacing the marrow.

ddx.dx: Fibrosis due to lymphoma or carcinoma infiltration
ddx.vs: Infiltrative neoplasms leave identifiable tumor cells in the fibrotic stroma that are revealed on H&E and immunostains.
Therapy-related fibrosis is diagnosed clinically and usually lacks the atypical megakaryocytic clusters and driver mutations of an MPN.
